text: [158] 68 dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ . katamehi dvīhi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu no ca sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti dhatānañca dhammānaṃ atthupaparikkhī hoti atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti no ca kalyāṇavāco hoti .pe. atthassa viññāpaniyā no ca sandassako hoti .pe. sabrahmacārīnaṃ . imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ .
